1. Character Development

To grow your character in the online world of silkroad, You have to advance your level. You can advance your level by hunting monsters. They can be hunted on open fields or dungeons out of villages or a castles. To hunt monsters effectively, you have to manage your HP(stamina) and MP(magic power). If your HP is 0, then your character will die. If your MP is insufficient, then you can't use magical or qigong skills. So you have to manage your HP and MP properly before going to hunt monsters.

Level Up
If you hunt a monster, you gain "Level Experience". and if you gain a certain amount of level experience, you achieve a "Level Up". If you achieve a level up, you can increase HP and MP through stat points, equip higher level weapons and defensive tools, and learn more powerful skills.

Auto Attack
To hunt a monster, place your mouse cursor over the monster, turning it to a sword icon. Double-click on it at this moment, then your character will automatically attack the monster. Unless you type anything or act differently, your attack against the monster will continue. And you can auto-attack if you use [ctrl + select] even without double-clicking on it.

Recovery
You have to restore HP and MP during combat if you are going to run out of them soon. If you are not in the state of fighting, they will be restored a bit automatically. If you are sitting on an open field using [sit] key, You can restore a little bit more. And you can also restore them with a "recovery item" which you can buy.


Abnormal State
Some monsters can cast the spell of "abnormal state" on you. when you're caught in this spell, you can see through the [character's state window] in the upper left of your screen.

* Abnormal States
1) Frozen - If you are frozen, you can't move or use skills for some time. But if your character has a [tolerance] to the freezing attack, the time of being frozen is reduced.
2) Frostbitten - If you are frostbitten, your movement is slowed over time. But if your character has a [tolerance] to the frostbite attack, the time of being frostbitten is reduced.
3) Electrically Shocked - If you are electrically shocked, your dodge is reduced over time. But if your character has a [tolerance] to the electrical shock attack, the time of being shocked is reduced.
4) Poisoned - If you are poisoned, you're given continuous damage over time. But if your character has a [tolerance] to the poisoning attack, the time of being poisoned is reduced.
5) Zombie - If you become a zombie and try to heal yourself, you'll be damaged over time instead of healed. But if your character has a [tolerance] to the zombie attack, the time of being a zombie is reduced.

2. To Cure The Abnormal State
The character in the abnormal state has to heal himself quickly by using a "abnormal state healing item" or "abnormal state recovery magic". You have to use the appropriate medicine by checking the syMPtoms of the abnormal state. For exaMPle, if you've been damaged with 30 seconds of abnormal state but if you use just 10 seconds effective recovery item then you will be under the abnormal state during the rest 20 seconds.

The Chinese tutorial contact is General Sonhyeon
General Sonhyeon is in front of the military camp near the west gate of Jangan.

First, you will be sent to Protector Trader Mrs Jang.
Second, you will undertake a request by Grocery Trader Jinjin
Third, buy a HP recovery herb from Herbalist Yangyun.
Last, you will hunt 30 Mangyangs

The tutorial will then end after your return to the General.
